note: The FileDescription of each PE file that a release ships, by file name (tools/build/versionstamp.py, BD-166). The release gate refuses a PE file of the package that is neither here nor third_party in release-sources.json nor exempt below. 'built' names a file that carries the resource from its own build (an .rc that includes the header of versionstamp.py rc-header): the release does not stamp it, and the gate checks it like a stamped file. 'exempt' names a file that carries no resource of the release, and why.

files.amdgpu_wddm_radv.dll: amdgpu-wddm Vulkan driver of the Direct3D and desktop drivers (RADV)

built.bc250kmd.sys: driver/kmd/bc250kmd.rc with version-stamp.h, compiled by driver/kmd/build.ps1: release-sources.json pins the KMD's Authenticode digest, so its resource is part of the build and a stamp after it would break the pin. The DirectX adapter record reads its DriverVersion from this file.
